items.title: Malformed ZIP Files Allows Attackers to Bypass Antivirus and EDR Detections
items.description: A critical flaw in how antivirus and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) systems process archive files. Tracked as CVE-2026-0866, this weakness allows attackers to use intentionally malformed ZIP headers to sneak malicious payloads past standard security scanners entirely undetected.
